input:
CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

ITEMS:

[I88] 【古代的时候】人觉得祭拜非常重要   correction: 古代的时候 → 在古代   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train)
  rule card (location_with_zai, Grammar): Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <place> is the location, so use 在+Place before the action.  Her terms: 在+Place, 在Place住, 住在+Place, 在Place + V., 在Place V1.着V2
  her past correction: 因为[-他们]觉得祭拜有很多好处 — her note: redundant
  her past correction: 因为他们觉得[祭拜有很多好处，对他们的生活→对生活有很多好处]
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜

[I89] 【孟子】很小的时候   correction: (comment, no correction)   strength: error
  checker's note: first appearance of 孟子: briefly introduce who this is
  rule card (first_mention_introduction, Coherence: reference): When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific.  Pattern: <name/pronoun> → <brief introduction to the person>: this character appears for the first time, so please introduce <person> briefly.
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧小的时候 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
  her past correction: ⟦孟子是孩子⟧ — her note: no logic relationship with the preceding or following sentences
  her past correction: ⟦孟子⟧出生以后 — her note: better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears

[I90] 【虽然】他没有朋友   correction: 虽然 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: 虽然 cannot introduce this causal statement without a matching contrast.
  rule card (conditional_jiu, Coherence: connectors): Use 只要……就 for an “as long as” condition, and use Subj. + 就 + V. to show the natural result; for an action that happens at an early age/number, use 才 Num.就V. Do not use 会 for this result, because 会 means “will” for the future.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <meaning/condition> leads naturally to <result>, so use 只要……就 or put the subject before 就 (Subj. + 就 + V.).  Her terms: 只要……就, Subj. + 就, Subj.+就, 才 Num.就V., 才Num.就V.
  her past correction: [他然后没有朋友→然后孟子失去了这个朋友] — her note: “他“ is ambiguous
  her past correction: 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction: 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as

[I91] 因为每天只【^】祭拜   correction: ∅ → 是   strength: suggestion
  rule card (zero_redundant_pronoun, Coherence: reference): When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <subject/possessive> is already clear, so delete it; Chinese uses zero form here.  Her terms: redundant, too many他, Subj.不是……而是……, Subj. before “不是……而是……”
  her past correction: 而是[-他]祭拜
  her past correction: 他们[一起常常→常常一起]去祭拜
  her past correction: [-所以他们]祭拜 — her note: there is no cause-effect relationship

[I92] 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑【了】   correction: 了 → (delete)   strength: error
  checker's note: habitual action with 老是 does not take sentence-final 了.
  rule card (le_completed, Coherence: temporality (了/着/在)): Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <action/change> is completed in the story, so it takes 了 (了completed).  Her terms: 了completed, 了completed/change, 着durative, 把
  her past correction: 他有的时候[-只要]跟朋友玩儿 — her note: or 他有的时候跟朋友玩儿
  her past correction: 他[-有的时候]只要跟朋友玩儿 — her note: wrong conjunctions, 他只要跟朋友玩儿 ; 只要……就as long as
  her past correction: 可是他们[老是有问题→碰到麻烦]

[I93] 孟子妈妈【看】了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响   correction: 看 → 看到   strength: error
  checker's note: her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train)
  rule card (perception_look_see, Vocabulary): 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: the person actually sees/catches sight of <thing or situation>, so use 看到, not 看.  Her terms: 看look vs.看到see, no了, 看look, 看到see
  her past correction: ⟦孟母看出来孟子老是难过，害得他不能好好学习。⟧孟母恐怕孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: miss information: 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices
  her past correction: 孟母看出来孟子老是[+很]难过 — her note: usually Adj. takes 很
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.

[I94] 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子【^】不好的影响   correction: ∅ → 有   strength: suggestion
  rule card (adjective_predicate_degree, Grammar): An Adj. can be the predicate without 是. Usually an Adj. takes 很 for a plain description; 是Adj.的 is used to emphasize.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: <adjective> is a plain description, so use it as the predicate without 是 and usually add 很.  Her terms: Adj. can be predicate, usually Adj. takes 很, 是Adj.的 is to emphasize
  her past correction: 孟母看出来孟子老是[+很]难过 — her note: usually Adj. takes 很
  her past correction: ⟦孟母看出来孟子老是难过，害得他不能好好学习。⟧孟母恐怕孟子住在墓地的旁边对孟子有影响 — her note: miss information: 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices
  her past correction: 害得对孟子[有→受到了]不好的影响 — her note: 害得+Sb.+V.

[I95] 所以孟子和孟子【^】妈妈搬家了   correction: ∅ → 的   strength: suggestion
  rule card (near_synonym_precision, Vocabulary): Choose the near-synonym that matches the intended event, duration, possibility, degree, or meaning; similar words are not interchangeable. For example, 高兴 is short-term and can change quickly, while 幸福 is for long-term, life-related happiness.  Pattern: <wrong> → <correct>: use <correct> because it means <intended meaning/context>; <wrong> is used for <different meaning/context>.  Her terms: 了completed
  her past correction: 所以妈妈跟孟子一起搬家[+了] — her note: 了completed
  her past correction: 所以妈妈[跟孟子一起→带孟子]搬家
  her past correction: [-所以]妈妈跟孟子一起搬家

items.explanation: 古代 is the location/time setting, so use 在+Place before the action: 在古代人觉得祭拜非常重要。
This is the first appearance of this character, so please introduce 孟子 briefly instead of using only his name.
虽然 needs a matching contrast, usually 虽然……但是…… . There is no contrast here, so delete 虽然.
It would be more natural to say 因为每天只是祭拜, using 是 to emphasize that this was the only activity.
老是 shows a habitual action, not an action completed in the story, so do not use 了completed here.
孟子妈妈 actually sees the bad influence, so use 看到see, not 看look.
It would be more natural to say 对孟子有不好的影响. Use 有 to show that the classmates' actions have a bad influence on 孟子.
It would be more natural to say 孟子的妈妈. Add 的 to show that the mother belongs to 孟子.
